title: RBI imposes monetary penalty on Manmad Urban Co-operative Bank Ltd., Manmad, Maharashtra
description: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has, by an order dated July 17, 2026, imposed a monetary penalty of ₹1 lakh (Rupees One Lakh only) on Manmad Urban Co-operative Bank Ltd., Manmad, Maharashtra (the bank) for non-compliance with certain directions issued by RBI on ‘Loans and Advances to Directors, their Relatives, and Firms / Concerns in which they are Interested’.
